entities.name: Query RAMP-like protein
observations: 177 aa sequence; predicted molecular weight 20.1 kDa and theoretical pI 5.93.
N-terminal signal-peptide-like region and C-terminal hydrophobic membrane anchor are consistent with a single-pass type I membrane protein.
Pfam RAMP domain PF04901.19 detected at residues 68–174 with i-Evalue 2.2e-41.
Closest reviewed reference is human RAMP2 (UniProt O60895), with 52.7% identity, 74.0% query coverage, and E-value 5.94e-41.
RAMP2 reference function includes GPCR coreceptor activity, CALCRL trafficking, and formation of adrenomedullin and calcitonin/amylin receptor complexes.
Functional assignment is supported mainly by homology and domain evidence; exact ligand specificity is inferred rather than directly demonstrated for the query sequence.

source_tools.relevance: Sequence properties, Pfam domain, and homology

entities.name: RAMP2
observations: Human receptor activity-modifying protein 2; UniProt O60895.
Reviewed annotation describes a single-pass type I cell-membrane protein that modulates GPCR function and is required for CALCRL plasma-membrane transport.
With CALCRL, forms an adrenomedullin receptor complex; with CALCR, forms calcitonin and amylin receptor complexes.
Annotated with coreceptor activity, adrenomedullin binding, plasma membrane/cell surface localization, and roles in GPCR signaling, angiogenesis, and adherens junction assembly.

source_tools.relevance: Reviewed UniProt functional, localization, complex, and GO annotations

entities.name: CALCRL
observations: Calcitonin receptor-like receptor; GPCR partner of RAMP2 in the adrenomedullin receptor complex.

entities.name: Adrenomedullin receptor signaling
observations: RAMP2/CALCRL receptor-complex signaling pathway involving a class B GPCR and RAMP coreceptor.
